caption:
For the friend lying in a hospital bed tonight

A short visit to someone who is ill is never small. The Prophet ﷺ said the one who visits the sick remains in the fruit garden of Paradise until he returns.

Sahih Muslim 6552 · Grade: Sahih

Text them now and plan the visit this week

#visitthesick #sunnah #hadithreels #kindness
alt_text: Thauban, the freed slave of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:He who visits the sick continues to remain in the fruit garden of Paradise until he returns (Sahih Muslim 6552)
